_note: The one place for Time Keeper's identity. Every step reads it: scene captions and banners, narration, music, logo and end card, export. Change it here, not in code.
name: Time Keeper

fonts._why: Clean and modern for luxury watches, already embedded in the renderer (OFL licence): Cairo for Arabic, Inter Tight for Latin.
fonts.caption: "Cairo","Inter Tight",system-ui,sans-serif

safe_area._why: Instagram/TikTok vertical: keep text clear of the app's top bar and bottom controls (in 720x1280 units).

narration.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, calm and natural documentary narration

music._why: Subtle cinematic bed under the voice. A track is used only with its commercial licence record next to it (same name, .licence.json); otherwise there is no music.
